evidence.section_heading: DeepSeek AI Guide: Chat, Models, API & Official Links
evidence.excerpt: DeepSeek is an AI company and product ecosystem with an official chat assistant, mobile apps, an API platform, and open-weight model releases. As verified on August 14, 2026, the current API IDs are `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`. Flash serves `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` in public beta. On August 13, DeepSeek rolled out `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` as GA on App, Web, and API. Both current API models support the native Responses API.
